verdict.rationale: Amplitude offers scriptable APIs that can drive operations across many items: cohort upload and export, event data export, taxonomy create/update/delete for event types and properties, and Experiment APIs for managing flags from CI or scripts. None of these is documented as a true bulk or batch operation, so multi-item work appears to require scripting loops over item-level APIs. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch endpoints or UI multi-select actions, documented batch limits and semantics, bulk operations via the MCP/AI interface, and independent hands-on corroboration.
